text: じっけんに　しっぱい　して　ポケモンと　くっついて　もうたんや　なッ！

structure.jp: じっけんに　しっぱい　して
structure.en: I failed at an experiment and

structure.jp: ポケモンと　くっついて　もうたんや　なッ！
structure.en: ended up stuck together with a Pokémon, y'see!

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.span: くっついて　もうた
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happened completely, often to your regret. もうた is the Kansai dialect way of saying しまった. くっついて　もうた = 'went and got stuck together'.

patterns.name: 〜のだ
patterns.explanation: のだ at the end makes the sentence an explanation of the situation. んや is the Kansai dialect way of saying it. くっついて　もうたんや = 'the thing is, I got stuck together'.

patterns.name: 〜て (linking)
patterns.explanation: The て-form joins one action to the next, here with a sense of 'and so'. じっけんに　しっぱい　して = 'I failed at the experiment and'.
